posts.title: DA directs landowners to clear debris caused by earth-cutting
posts.description: [ Bengia Ajum ] HOLLONGI, 6 Aug: After major damage was caused to NH 415 a few kilometres before the Donyi Polo International Airport due to earth-cutting by private individuals near the highway, the Papum Pare district administration has directed the landowners to clear the debris. posts.title: Nadda assures full central support after visiting flood-hit Arunachal
posts.description: ITANAGAR, 6 Aug: Union Minister JP Nadda on Thursday assured the Centre’s full support for relief, rehabilitation and reconstruction in flood-hit Arunachal Pradesh after visiting the worst-affected areas of Keyi Panyor district and reviewing the damage caused by recent flash floods and landslides. posts.title: Rijiju calls up Gandhi again, seeks Cong’s support on delimitation bill
posts.description: NEW DELHI, 6 Aug: Union minister Kiren Rijiju on Thursday had a telephonic conversation with Congress leader Rahul Gandhi to seek support for the passage of the women’s reservation and delimitation bill, but the leader of opposition insisted on convening an all-party meeting on the proposed legislation, sources aware of the matter said.
